description:
List on-duty pharmacies

Pharmacies currently on duty, sorted by city. Always returns on-duty pharmacies only — the shared `duty` filter does not apply here.

GET /v1/pharmacy/pharmacies/on-duty on Nöbetçi Eczane (SBX-ECZ). Costs 1 credit per call.

activelyOnDuty.description: `true` = duty shift active now (Europe/Istanbul, start inclusive, end exclusive); `false` = not active now. Such answers carry `Cache-Control: no-store`, no `ETag`, and are never answered `304`. `false` does not mean closed.

city.description: Filter by city name (case- and accent-insensitive). Up to 120 characters.

cursor.description: Opaque; the `next_cursor` of the previous page. Keep every other parameter unchanged, or the call is a 400.

district.description: Filter by district name (case- and accent-insensitive). Up to 120 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of items on this page.

name.description: Turkish-aware substring match on pharmacy name. Up to 120 characters. `q` is an alias for this parameter.

name: pharmacy_listDutyPharmacies
title: Nöbetçi Eczane: List on-duty pharmacies
